verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is the founder's description of Zero as an AI email client that auto-categorizes the inbox. Custom labels and filtering by labels via MCP are adjacent building blocks, not split streams. No documentation shows split-inbox views, named streams (important, team, newsletters, calendar invites), or priority-ordered triage. Missing for 10: documented split-inbox or stream views, specific category definitions, priority-order triage flow, first-party docs and hands-on corroboration of auto-categorization.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
